# Council Board Resources

### Board Documents

Multiple documents, templates, and sample resolutions useful in the governance
of the council, and as an aid to inform board members of their
responsibilities.

  * [Council Annual Report Contents](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/mission/doc/Council_Annual_Report_contents.doc)
  * [Council Election Procedures](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/Council-Election-Procedures.docx)
  * [Nondiscrimination Policy 2017](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/mission/doc/nondiscrimination-policy-2017.docx)
  * [Electronic Meeting Wording](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/mission/doc/electronic_meeting_wording.doc)
  * [Executive Board Diversity Survey](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/mission/doc/Executive_Board_Diversity_Survey.doc)

### [Board Member Evaluation
Chart](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/mission/xls/board_member_evaluation_chart.xls)

This chart will measure performance in meeting attendance and participation,
committee activity, and fundraising among other categories.

### [Board Retreat
template](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/mission/xls/board_retreat.xls)

This is a draft template for a 4-hour board retreat to discuss your Voice of
the Scout results and comments, and your Journey to Excellence (JTE) criteria
scores. The tabs across the bottom of the document are various resources for
the retreat.

### [Council Executive Board Orientation
(CEBO)](https://www.scouting.org/council-support/cebo/)

This link is the electronic version of the Council Executive Board Orientation
notebook that was sent to every council in 2007. All executive board training
modules and teaching notes are now online here for your use in training your
board.

### [Executive Board Job Profile Templates](/council-support/council-
management-support/executive-board-templates)

Sample job profile templates for executive board level positions done in Word
format so you can revise them to fit your council’s needs. These can also be
used ‘as is’ by filling in the council, volunteer name, and key meeting dates.

### [Orientation Guide for Council Officers and Executive Board Members
(33161) ](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/mission/pdf/33161-2007.pdf)

Great orientation guide for new council officers, executive board members, and
council Key 3’s. Depending on how you use it, it could raise your Journey to
Excellence score.
